verdict.rationale: The only first-party hint of a CLI is the API reference's statement that every endpoint has a generated command. That implies a command-line surface mapped to the API, but the evidence never names a CLI, its install, its auth, or any agent-oriented usage, and other command-line material (curl examples, a repo quickstart script) does not count as a CLI. Missing for 10: an explicitly named official CLI tool, installation and auth docs, a command reference, AI-native/agent workflow usage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Every endpoint in this reference has a generated command.
